{{Recipe}}

'''Ogolale''', also known as '''oritobor''', is a dish of mashed [[Cookbook:Yam|yam]], unripe [[Cookbook:Plantain|plantain]], and [[Cookbook:Palm Oil|palm oil]]. It is popular with the people of the Niger Delta.
==Ingredients==

* [[Cookbook:Yam|Yam]]
* Unripe [[Cookbook:Plantain|plantain]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* [[Cookbook:Palm Oil|Palm oil]]

==Procedure==
# [[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] the yam and plantain in a pot of salted water until cooked through.
# Drain the water, and transfer the cooked yam and plantain to a clean container.
# Use a spoon or spatula to [[Cookbook:Mashing|mash]] the yam and plantain.
# Mix in the palm oil.
# Adjust seasoning to taste, and serve.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Additional ingredients may be added according to taste.
